description: FREE. Catalog of all ausref reference-data series: supported countries, series ids, descriptions, freshness metadata and per-series URLs. Call this first to discover what data exists. Paid answer tools accept receipt=true (included in the answer price, no extra USDC) and, on a paid success, return an Ed25519 answer receipt (kind answer_receipt). That receipt is not a series certified extract and is not legal advice. Series certified extracts are GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} at $0.10 and are not an MCP tool. Verify a receipt with verify_answer_receipt (free, public key only) against /certified/public-key. get_changes is free. get_calendar is free. register_alert registration is free.

country.description: Optional ISO country code. Returns full per-series metadata (source, freshness, bands) for that country only.

detail.description: Default false. Without country, false returns a compact index (country -> series ids). true returns the full catalog, which is large.

name: list_series

outputSchema.description: Catalog: brand metadata plus countries[] (compact: country, name, series ids; with country or detail: full per-series metadata including confidence_label and coverage_label)

countries.description: Country entries ({country, name, series}); on an unknown-country refusal, the list of valid codes

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card
